units.source_text: 基本上每个星期，丈夫都会带着信子到大阪城里或者郊区游玩。

en.t: Almost every week, her husband would take Nobuko out to Osaka Castle or to the suburbs.

units.source_text: 每当在火车、电车等公共场合，看到那些大吃大喝举止粗鲁的人，

en.t: Whenever she saw people eating and drinking greedily and behaving rudely in public places such as trains and streetcars,

units.source_text: 信子就会越发觉得彬彬有礼的丈夫高雅不俗，是自己的骄傲。

en.t: Nobuko would feel all the more that her courteous husband was refined and above the common run, and that he was her pride.

units.source_text: 的确是这样，不管是帽子、西装，还是红色的高腰皮靴，丈夫的衣着总是光鲜亮丽，散发着好闻的香皂的香气。

en.t: And it was true: whether it was his hat, his suit, or his red high leather boots, her husband's clothes were always bright and immaculate, giving off a pleasant scent of soap.

units.source_text: 这在暑假期间，他们夫妻一起去舞子参加聚会，和那些同在一个茶室的丈夫的同事们相比，信子就更加感到自豪。

en.t: She felt this pride even more during the summer holidays, when the couple went together to a gathering in Maiko and she compared him with his colleagues who were in the same tea room.

units.source_text: 不过，信子没想到，丈夫和那些看起来粗鲁的同事们似乎关系很好。

en.t: But Nobuko had not expected that her husband seemed to be on good terms with those rough-looking colleagues.
